create.name: Cindy Kaza
create.bio:
Cindy Kaza is an American evidential medium and artist, familiar to many viewers from her years on the Travel Channel series The Dead Files, as well as Ghosts of Devil's Perch and The Holzer Files. She traces her sense of the unseen back to a vivid encounter at the age of ten, shortly after a school friend died, which she put down to a dream at the time. Only in her twenties did she come to understand such experiences as mediumship, and she went on to train in the United States and at the Arthur Findlay College in Stansted, England, the well-known British centre for the study of mediumship.

Today her teaching is mostly online. She runs occasional three-hour workshops on themes such as automatic writing, and a small monthly mentorship in which around ten students meet her one to one each week over Zoom, with a shared group session, to work on skills such as clairvoyance, blending with spirit, symbolism, psychometry and discernment between intuition and imagination. She also draws what she calls spirit guide art in ink, appears at live demonstration evenings, and co-leads group journeys to sacred sites, most recently in Egypt. Her approach stresses that everyone has some intuitive ability that can be developed with patience and care.

courses.title: A Medium's Guide To Connecting To Automatic Writing
courses.description: A three-hour online workshop for all levels on automatic, or channelled, writing. Cindy shares ways of letting writing flow as a means of contact with guides and the wider unseen.

courses.title: Individual Mediumship Development: December, 2026
courses.description: A one-month mentorship on Zoom for up to ten students: four weekly 90-minute private sessions with Cindy plus one group workshop. Sessions are shaped around each student, from clairvoyance and evidence to symbols, psychometry and spirit art.

courses.title: Individual Mediumship Development: January, 2027
courses.description: The January round of her monthly one-to-one mediumship mentorship on Zoom, limited to ten students, with four weekly private sessions and a group workshop.

courses.title: Mystical Egypt 2.0
courses.description: A group journey to the temples and sacred sites of ancient Egypt, led with Lauren Rainbow, including some private site visits. Booking is through Lauren Rainbow's sacred travel page.
